cohort: Preterm infants between 25 0/7 and 32 6/7 weeks gestation admitted to a Level III NICU between January 2023 and March 2024.
finding: Poractant alfa offers practical advantages such as a higher initial dose, lower cost, and reduced need for a second repeat dose compared to calfactant, while yielding comparable short- and mid-term morbidity and mortality outcomes.
